biggest_catch: Your friend must park a real $1,000 in Public before either of you gets anything — and you cannot withdraw the $100 reward's cash value for 12 months without an early-withdrawal fee of up to $100.
catches: Friend must make an initial one-time deposit of at least $1,000 (smaller installments do not qualify).
Reward is $100 of a chosen stock or ETF (fractional share), not cash; value may move with the market.
You have 30 days to claim the reward or it expires permanently.
The cash value of the reward may not be withdrawn for 12 months after it is claimed — withdrawing early can trigger a fee of up to $100.
You can earn up to $500 of rewards through promotions and offers on the Public app (after $500 you can no longer participate, though your link stays valid).
US residents only; referrals limited to people with whom you have a direct personal relationship; no spam or commercial use; employees/regulator staff excluded.
Referrer must have a funded Public Investing brokerage account in good standing.
Public may change or terminate the program at any time; term began January 20, 2026.
Reward value may be reported as Other Income on a 1099-Misc; taxes are the participant's responsibility.

c1.evidence: Open to the Public Investing, Inc. — real brokerage; official public.com disclosures referral terms page.

c2.evidence: Official 'REFERRAL PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS' on public.com with the $100 amount, $1,000 deposit rule, 30-day claim, 12-month hold, and $500 cap.

c3.evidence: Free to participate; no fee to open an account for the referral program (friend's $1,000 is a deposit, not a fee).

c4.evidence: Official terms: 'you will both receive $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice' and 'receive a notional value of $100 of this asset'.

eligibility: Referrer must have a funded Public Investing brokerage account in good standing. Friend must be a new user with a direct personal relationship to the referrer, use the referral link, be approved, and make an initial one-time deposit of at least $1,000. US residents only.
notes: Official terms reviewed 2026-09-23. The reward is stock/ETF value, not cash — disclosed honestly. No Public referral route exists in the catalog (only the generic brokerage promo R0019), so no duplication. Program term began 2026-01-20 with no fixed end date.
payout_quote: Official terms: 'For each friend or family member who makes a deposit of at least $1,000, you will both receive $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice.' Claim terms: 'You have 30 days to claim your Reward. Your Reward will expire after 30 days.' Hold terms: 'The cash value of the Reward ... may not be withdrawn for 12 months after it is claimed or else your brokerage account may be subject to an early withdrawal fee of up to $100.' Cap: 'You may earn up to $500 of rewards through promotions and offers on the Public app.'

steps: Open and fund your Public Investing brokerage account.
Copy your unique referral link from the app (Rewards button > Earn free stock) and send it to a friend or family member.
Your friend uses your link to sign up for a Public brokerage account and gets approved.
Your friend makes an initial one-time deposit of at least $1,000.
Public alerts you both when you are cleared to claim.
Each of you claims $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice within 30 days.
Hold the reward for 12 months to avoid the early-withdrawal fee of up to $100.
timing: Claim within 30 days of qualification; reward value locked from withdrawal for 12 months.
